_meta.description: Paid/syndicated data vendor catalog for US major-appliance & laundry-center market share/shipment/POS data — purchase paths, published prices, reliability tiers
_meta.collection_method: All direct vendor-site fetches blocked by environment egress proxy; every item provenance=search_snippet. Nothing inferred beyond what snippets stated; unpublished prices marked quote-based.
_meta.bottom_line: Only vendors with publicly observable prices: Statista ($199/$1,399 per month, annual billing), IBISWorld ($2,850 full report / $800 Spotlight), Freedonia Focus series ($900-$1,100 via marketresearch.com), AHAM store items (member/non-member differential; one digest cited $350 vs $5,000 — indicative only). Brand-share-for-laundry specifically comes from exactly two syndicated sources: TraQline/OpenBrand Durable IQ (survey panel, quarterly) and Circana (retail POS) — both quote-based.

paid_data_catalog.product: Durable IQ (renamed from 'TraQline' flagship, 2023) + free MarketSignal quarterly dashboards
paid_data_catalog.what_you_get_for_laundry_centers: Quarterly US consumer-survey market share for durable goods incl. major appliances/laundry: brand share, retailer share, price points, online vs brick-and-mortar, demographics, purchase drivers. Free MarketSignal 'Major Appliances' dashboard showed brand unit share: 'Whirlpool (22.2% unit share) and GE (21.4%) holding the top spots'. Laundry-center-specific breakout not directly observed in snippets.
paid_data_catalog.granularity: Brand + retailer share, category level (claims 170+ categories, 2,500+ brands, 1,000+ outlets); quarterly; channel split; model-level not observed
paid_data_catalog.published_price: quote-based (no subscription pricing published; MarketSignal dashboards described as free 'without a subscription')
paid_data_catalog.reliability_claim: Survey-based tracker, not POS: 'run quarterly since 2001... surveys 600,000 households in the United States each year, or 150,000 per quarter', 90-day purchase recall; the share source cited in Samsung/LG press coverage

paid_data_catalog.product: Retail POS market measurement + receipt/scan panel + survey (Complete Market, Market Share Drivers, Liquid Data); Appliances industry practice
paid_data_catalog.what_you_get_for_laundry_centers: Retail POS tracking for appliances; 2026 UK-launch announcement describes 'weekly and monthly sales insights' applying 'Circana's US data taxonomy... categories, hierarchies and product attributes', indicating an existing North American home-appliance POS service with item/attribute-level hierarchy. Laundry-center category depth not directly observed.
paid_data_catalog.granularity: POS by retailer/channel/price tier with product attributes; weekly and monthly cadence
paid_data_catalog.reliability_claim: Primary POS panel (highest tier): 'monitors point-of-sale transactions from 290 million households globally'; 'calibrates its panel to POS data with over 1,100 retail partners in the U.S.'

paid_data_catalog.product: Major Appliance Factory Shipment Report (FSR, incl. 'Media Only' edition) + Major Appliance Annual Shipment Trends 1989-2025; sold via aham.org store
paid_data_catalog.what_you_get_for_laundry_centers: Industry-level factory shipment units (not brand share): 'current month over month and year-to-date comparisons, including domestic and import unit shipments along with percentage change'. Annual Shipment Trends explicitly includes 'home laundry appliances'. No brand or model split observed.
paid_data_catalog.granularity: Product-category unit shipments (industry aggregate), monthly data; subscription 'per person, not per entity'
paid_data_catalog.published_price: Listed on store pages but not visible in snippets; one search digest cited an AHAM data product at '$350.00 member / $5,000.00 non-member' (product not identifiable from snippet — indicative only, verify on ItemDetail page)
paid_data_catalog.pricing_model: Per-report/subscription purchase from AHAM store; member vs non-member pricing
paid_data_catalog.reliability_claim: Primary manufacturer-reported shipments: 'the source for the home appliance industry's most accurate data on major home appliance shipments'; FSR called 'the most reliable factory shipment data available'

paid_data_catalog.product: Statista platform subscriptions; Market Insights (Consumer Market Outlook) 'Household Appliances / Major Appliances / Washing Machines - United States'
paid_data_catalog.what_you_get_for_laundry_centers: Modeled market revenue/volume forecasts (US household appliances 'market volume of US$72.02bn in 2029'; major appliances 'volume... 54.8m pieces by 2030'), plus curated third-party stats (some charts cite TraQline). NO brand share of its own; no laundry-center model data.
paid_data_catalog.granularity: Category-level market size/forecast, country level; no brand/model/retailer share
paid_data_catalog.published_price: Starter Account $199 USD/month billed annually (single user); Professional Account $1,399 USD/month billed annually (teams up to 5, includes Reports and Market Insights); prices exclude sales tax; annual auto-renew
paid_data_catalog.pricing_model: Published self-serve subscription tiers; annual contract
paid_data_catalog.reliability_claim: Aggregator + modeled outlooks (washer 'Market Insights' figures are forecasts) — modeled estimate tier, not a POS panel

paid_data_catalog.product: 'Major Household Appliance Manufacturing in the US' industry report (industry 789)
paid_data_catalog.what_you_get_for_laundry_centers: US industry sizing (observed: 'market size... $25.0bn in 2024', '$24.8bn in 2025, decreased -0.8%'), trends, major-company analysis; industry-level manufacturing view, not retail brand share by category
paid_data_catalog.granularity: Industry level, company profiles; annual updates
paid_data_catalog.published_price: US Industry Research Report: US $2,850 per report; Industry Spotlight Report: US $800
paid_data_catalog.reliability_claim: Modeled estimate tier: sources 'US Census Bureau and industry-specific sources'; forecasts via 'regression analysis and driver growth rate models'

paid_data_catalog.product: Freedonia Focus Report 'Major Household Appliances: United States' (ff90017) + 'Global Major Household Appliances' industry study
paid_data_catalog.what_you_get_for_laundry_centers: US Focus report: 'high-level overview... demand & shipment forecasts through 2028 segmented by product & market' with 'Market Leaders' section. Category-level (laundry as a product segment); no brand-share tracking, no model-level.
paid_data_catalog.granularity: Product-segment demand/shipments, annual snapshots; market-leader qualitative profiles
paid_data_catalog.published_price: US report price not observed; sibling Freedonia Focus appliance reports listed on marketresearch.com at USD $900 (Sept 2024 editions) and USD $1,100 (Europe, Aug 2024)

CAGR 6.7%'); segment splits and company landscape; not POS, no model-level data; '20% free customization'
